name: Upcoming launch notices
description: Fetch-plan and normalization nodes for upcoming-launch notices from a public launch registry (Launch Library 2) (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON between modules). plan_launches turns a TimerTick into ONE HttpRequest whose CONTEXT is the plan, a size-prefixed IngestRequest skeleton (schema LDM.fbs, provider launch-schedule, source upcoming, the canonical URL naming the page size, the producer peer id, terms and citation, reconcile Current), reading node CONFIG launch_schedule_source.access / .limit and launch_schedule_producer_peer_id through the builtin plugin.getConfig hostcall (SDS $PIV). parse_launches takes the HttpResponse, requires the echoed plan to be canonical, validates the whole page and emits binary $LDM with each launch window, the IngestRequest for hostcap/storage-ingest and a FlowNotice report; it makes no host call. Generic host HTTP, scheduling, storage and publication supply network transport.

sequentialJustification.detail: Bounded deterministic request planning (one plugin.getConfig hostcall) and binary normalization of one registry page. No threads or network access.

acceptedTypeSets.description: TimerTick (TICK) from the scheduling adapter (fields not read); the plan comes from node CONFIG launch_schedule_source.* (access anonymous, limit 1-100).

inputPorts.description: TimerTick (TICK) from the scheduling adapter (fields not read); the plan comes from node CONFIG launch_schedule_source.* (access anonymous, limit 1-100).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ) GET of the registry's upcoming page, TIMEOUT_MS 30000, MAX_BYTES 4 MiB; CONTEXT the plan: one size-prefixed IngestRequest (SCHEMA LDM.fbs, TAGS PROVIDER_ID launch-schedule, SOURCE_NAME upcoming, SOURCE_URL the canonical URL, SOURCE_PEER the producer peer id, LICENSE_URL the registry terms, CITATION; RECONCILE Current).

outputPorts.description: HttpRequest (HREQ) GET of the registry's upcoming page, TIMEOUT_MS 30000, MAX_BYTES 4 MiB; CONTEXT the plan: one size-prefixed IngestRequest (SCHEMA LDM.fbs, TAGS PROVIDER_ID launch-schedule, SOURCE_NAME upcoming, SOURCE_URL the canonical URL, SOURCE_PEER the producer peer id, LICENSE_URL the registry terms, CITATION; RECONCILE Current).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP): STATUS (200 required), BODY the registry JSON, CONTEXT the unmodified plan (parsing refuses a plan that differs from the canonical plan of its URL or carries no producer peer id), RETRIEVED_MS the host's retrieval time.

inputPorts.description: HttpResponse (HRSP): STATUS (200 required), BODY the registry JSON, CONTEXT the unmodified plan (parsing refuses a plan that differs from the canonical plan of its URL or carries no producer peer id), RETRIEVED_MS the host's retrieval time.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed binary LDM stream, one per upcoming launch with its NET and window.

outputPorts.description: Size-prefixed binary LDM stream, one per upcoming launch with its NET and window.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (INGQ) for hostcap/storage-ingest: the plan's tags with BATCH_ID = SHA-256 of the response body, RECONCILE Current, PROVENANCE (status, validators, retrieval time, parser, source SHA-256, record count).

outputPorts.description: IngestRequest (INGQ) for hostcap/storage-ingest: the plan's tags with BATCH_ID = SHA-256 of the response body, RECONCILE Current, PROVENANCE (status, validators, retrieval time, parser, source SHA-256, record count).

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) Info, REASON normalized: COUNT the records, AT_MS the retrieval time, ITEMS registry-count:<n> and skipped-imprecise:<launch id> for each launch skipped for an unsupported NET precision; never a dataset record.

outputPorts.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) Info, REASON normalized: COUNT the records, AT_MS the retrieval time, ITEMS registry-count:<n> and skipped-imprecise:<launch id> for each launch skipped for an unsupported NET precision; never a dataset record.
